Specification of Diagnostics AUTOSAR AP R25-11 [SWS_DM_01527] ara::diag::DoIPGroupIdentification not yet offered when DM needs to retrieve GID Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00026 ⌈ If the DM shall send the GID while the Offer function of the ara::diag::DoIP- GroupIdentification interface was not called yet by the Adaptive Application that provides it, the DM shall send a GID value equal to 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 0x00 or 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF ("value not set"), as defined in Table 5 and Table 1 in the ISO 13400-2[2] specification. ⌋ [SWS_DM_00815] Triggering vehicle announcement messages Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04242 ⌈ If ara::diag::DoIPTriggerVehicleAnnouncement::TriggerVehicleAn- nouncement is called, the DM shall trigger vehicle announcement messages accord- ing to ISO 13400-2[2] on the interface identified via networkInterfaceId . ⌋ [SWS_DM_00816] Notification of activation line status change on activation line controlled network interfaces Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04242 ⌈ If the DM detects an activation line change to active via the interface ara::diag:: DoIPActivationLine , the DM shall send the vehicle announcement messages ac- cording to ISO 13400-2[2]. ⌋ The DM needs to instantiate a singleton of ara::diag::DoIPTriggerVehi- cleAnnouncement only. The ara::diag::DoIPTriggerVehicleAnnounce- ment::TriggerVehicleAnnouncement method gets the according network- InterfaceId passed, to which the DoIP Vehicle Announcement Message (see [SWS_DM_00449]) shall be sent. Different AAs monitoring the DoIP Activation Line will inform the DM about an Activation Line toggle on its monitoring networkInter- faceId .

About "DiagnosticDoIPTriggerVehicleAnnouncementInterface" As mentioned in [SWS_DM_00816], the DM is responsible to send the "Vehicle An- nouncement Message" upon detection of an established link on the network interface. The mechanism "TriggerVehicleAnnouncement" is foreseen as DM internal functional- ity, which depends solely on the two scenarios, as defined in the ISO 13400-2: • send Vehicle Announcement Message on network startup (broadcast to other IP-based ECUs, Gateways, etc). • send Vehicle Announcement Message on connection of an external tester (de- tection of connected IP-based ECUs). This specification, however, defines a port interface "DiagnosticDoIPTriggerVehicleAn- nouncementInterface" [SWS_DM_00820], which implies, that an AA could explicitly trigger the sending of the "Vehicle Announcement Message".
